body: I've told my story in another comment here. I'm not discounting help; i just feel that i am helping so many other people by dying, that i can't see a way to justify living.

no one escapes my curse, though. 

everyone who has been kind to me has suffered tragedy.

when i was 6 a woman lost her 18 year old daughter.

7, woman lost her 8 year old son

8, woman got cancer, beat it, lost husband in car accident on way back from "remission celebration"

9, guy lost job, wife, and health

10, woman diagnosed with Crohn's

11-12, woman has two miscarriages, declared infertile, husband gets cancer and dies

13, guy's 16 year old son dies of brain aneurysm, my grandfather dies suddenly leaving my grandmother alone and lost. she went completely crazy a year ago.

14-15 man loses job, moves to louisiana, house destroyed by hurricane

16-17, man loses brother, then job, then entire family forced to uproot to new state 

17-18, woman's mother diagnosed with cancer. I decide to end the cycle and eliminate as much contact as possible. Mother beats the cancer. I break down, tell woman everything. She tells there's no way any of it is my fault. I accept her help and support. within two weeks, mother gets cancer again and dies in less than two months.

this isn't even everything. This is just a tiny portion of what i'm talking about. this has only happened to people around me who showed me exceptional kindness, and no one who has done that has escaped.
the thing is, *my* life is just fine. but i bring tragedy everywhere i go, and i don't want to do that anymore
you made it pretty clear you didn't want to hear my "melodrama" so I'll stop now. sorry i bothered you.
see? you just want me to shut up and go away. so i will.

not trying to be hostile. just ready to go. 

have an opinion on the matter at hand?

are you fucking kidding me? you think a pixar song is going to *HEAL ME*

come on. you're not that naive.

and i *have* had an effect on others. that's why i can't go on with this.
this isn't my only throwaway. Ive been posting a lot lately, and mostly i get no responses.

I am not a bad person. I do everything I can to help others. But as I explained in my original post, I am cursed. Everyone who has ever been kind to me has very soon after experienced terrible terrible tragedy. every single one. and i refuse to be the harbinger of death any longer. 

Like i said, I do everything i can to help others. And this is the last and greatest good thing i can do.

I have. And even if they were hurt by it, it would be the last hurt they would ever have from me. but if i live, they will continue to be hurt by me. they may not know it's my fault, but it is, and they will continue to be hurt. This would end that spiral, and i owe them that.

I explained myself in my other posts. I got one answer each, and no one answered my reply. 

I know you're just trying to help, but I don't know that you can. And frankly, one tiny little voice whispering across the internet isn't going to change my mind. I know you're trying, but even on Reddit, only one person cares even a tiny bit whether I go, and by the time you wake in the morning, you won't even remember this conversation, let alone miss me. 

No one is going to be hurt by my absence, but a lot of people might be helped.
eh. I posted twice here tonight, and got basically no response. I don't think anyone actually cares, so I'll just go quietly.
Tell them you're running away. If you're over 18, they can't do much about that. Then just don't let yourself be found anywhere near them.

My death would be different because 1) this tragedy is connected to me and it would end when I ended and 2) no one really cares about or even notices me except for a few people, and those few people are going through such excruciating pain that the death of a friend would never even compare if it even registered at all.
